sampleRecords.event_description: Fall to lower level resulting from exposure or contact  6 to 30 feet
sampleRecords.final_narrative: An employee was on an extension ladder, pumping concrete inside a block wall. A stone plugged the concrete hose, causing a pressure increase. As the stone was released, the hose whipped against the employee, who fell from the ladder to the ground 6 feet below. He suffered a leg injury and was hospitalized.

sampleRecords.event_description: Other fall to lower level, unspecified
sampleRecords.final_narrative: An employee was on a ladder pouring concrete when a concrete hose burst, knocking the employee off the ladder. They sustained right hand and wrist fractures.

sampleRecords.event_description: Other fall to lower level 6 to 10 feet
sampleRecords.final_narrative: On July 28, 2022, an employee was on the second floor of a residence setting up concrete pump hoses when they tripped on wood partitions on the floor and fell into a temporary guardrail. The guardrail gave away and the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, resulting in a fracture to his left foot.

sampleRecords.event_description: Pedestrian struck by forward-moving vehicle in nonroadway area
sampleRecords.final_narrative: While checking a car, an employee was struck by another vehicle being driven by a coworker. The employee was pinned between the car and the building, suffering a fractured pelvis.

sampleRecentRecalls.summary: Ferrari North America, Inc. (Ferrari) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Purosangue vehicles. The fuse box’s power supply and the passenger-side footrest may contact each other, possibly resulting in a short circuit that activates the brake warning light and decreases the vehicle's braking ability.
sampleRecentRecalls.consequence: A loss of braking ability increases the risk of a crash.
sampleRecentRecalls.remedy: Ferrari will install a plastic spacer between the fuse box’s power supply and the passenger-side footrest, free of charge. Owner notification letters are scheduled to be mailed by September 21, 2025.
